personality_one_liner: A cinematic, expensive, and flowy financial command center that feels like an exclusive club.

spacing.rule: Generous breathing room. Elements should feel intentionally placed, never cramped. Use large safe-area margins.

do's: Use heavy glass with translucent underlying tint for featured home cards over background imagery.
Use glass for sticky bottom navigation and headers.
Ensure foreground text on glass is highly readable via underlying >= 75% opacity dark scrims.
dont's: Don't apply glass to basic list rows, chips, or inputs.
Don't rely on blur alone; always use a tinted base.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Define daily expense limits (Mon-Sun) with a flowy progress bar.

states.error: Soft red snackbar at the top.

screens.layout: Screen fills 0% to 100% via a thin, rounded horizontal bar with a gradient fill and soft easing. The day selector is a dynamic list below the bar. As one day is filled, it softly transitions into completed state and the next day fades in. Large Fraunces titles set the cinematic tone.

screens.name: PreHomeGate
screens.purpose: Strict gate to force logging of scheduled expenses before accessing Home.
screens.layout: Implemented as a non-dismissible stacked full-screen glass modal over the blurred Home screen. Dark, immersive, forces the user to clear pending limits to 'unlock' the app.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard displaying current Savings, Spoilance, and quick actions.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders with shimmer on cards.

screens.layout: Features two large glass hero cards (Savings and Spoilance) resting over an abstract dark flowing wave background. Use a vertical gradient scrim to ensure ₹ numbers are legible. Quick action buttons (Edit Daily Limits, AI Advisor) sit below in a clean 2-column grid. The Spoilance Logger is a prominent floating glass FAB.

screens.name: SpoilanceLogger
screens.purpose: Log expenses dynamically with a live animated running total.

states.empty: Initial state asking for item count.

screens.layout: Starts with an elegant prompt for item count. Upon entry, a dynamic list of rows expands fluidly. At the top, a large, sticky Fraunces running total animates (number counter effect) as the user types costs. Uses bottom sheet for entry.

screens.name: EditDailyLimits
screens.layout: Day selector chips in a sticky horizontal scroll row. Form fields use `surfaceTertiary` with large tap targets. A sticky 'Save' button is pinned at the bottom, above the safe area.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: View daily/monthly spending and all-time totals.

states.empty: Charcoal textured background with a subtle 'No records' text.

screens.layout: Refined list view. Dates and totals are in Fraunces, metadata in Manrope. Monthly summaries are separated by subtle glass section headers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark, premium District-like aesthetic. Pure black is forbidden; rely on Midnight Obsidian (#0B0B0E) and Charcoal (#16161A).
Use Fraunces strictly for large numeric values (₹ balances) and primary titles. Use Manrope for everything else.
Implement the flowy progress bar in Onboarding using Reanimated, ensuring a smooth determinate fill.
The Spoilance Logger running total MUST have a live animated number counter effect.
The PreHomeGate must act as a strict modal that obscures the Home screen (heavy blur) until the user logs the missing expenses.
Apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 1) over the abstract wave background on the Home cards to guarantee text readability.
No blue or purple allowed. Use Champagne Gold for accents and Emerald solely for success/money.
